body: The whistle and first aid kit are sealed together, never opened. Soot darkens the bundle. The clean outlines suggest it was packed before the fire.
title: Whistle and first aid kit

body: I found a notebook with dates beside yellowing in plots seven to ten. A water bottle next to it holds murky brown sediment. The final entry has 'east drainage' circled three times.
title: notebook and water bottle
